{{Top|leg}}
The '''Dinner''' was the main event of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Granee Noopa]]. During the Dinner, the Granee Noopa's contestants were set against one or more beasts and had to avoid getting eaten. Those who survived moved on to the [[Closing Ceremony]].<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
